thought.text: **XPlanWMS now returns HTTP 200!** The deegree workspace restart via the `/config` API-key endpoint re-loaded the remote MapServer resource successfully. Let me verify the WMS capabilities content and run the full endpoint verification:

reasoning_content:
Awesome! The `/config/restart` worked (the deegree workspace was reloaded), and now WMS GetCapabilities via the proxy is returning **HTTP 200**!

Let's verify the WMS capabilities content and run a full verification of all endpoints.

action.command: echo "=== WMS capabilities content ==="; timeout 40 curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wms/services/wms?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities&version=1.1.1" | grep -oE "WMT_MS_Capabilities|<Title>[^<]*</Title>" | head -8
